description: Full IP intelligence for an IPv4 or IPv6 address, geolocation (country, city, state, postal code, lat/long, timezone, local time), ISP/ASN/org, ownership fields (ASN, owner name, network range, owner domain -- each with its source, null with a reason when no source states it), and security risk flags (VPN, proxy, Tor, datacenter, mobile + a 0-100 risk score). For "which company owns this IP" call rdap_ip, the registry source for ownership; this tool adds geolocation and risk. Keyless.

ip.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up, e.g. "8.8.8.8" or "2606:4700:4700::1111".
